sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be favorites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once all season. This is a golden opportunity for the leaders to bounce back and extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tricky away fixture at Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the two-point gap on Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall at home, with both sides showing recent improvement and battling for Champions League qualification spots. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a battle between mid-table sides, then face Brereton Social in a midweek clash on Wednesday. Bilston Town visit Foley Meir seeking to maintain their strong recent form after three straight wins. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a fixture between sides struggling for consistency, while Crewe host fellow mid-table underperformers Allscott Heath. Barnton welcome Shawbury United—a side in crisis with six consecutive losses—offering Barnton a genuine chance to build momentum. Cheadle Heath Nomads face a daunting trip to in-form Bilston, and Telford Town visit Cheadle Heath. Widnes Town, bottom with just 2 points, travel to Brereton Social in a clash between the division's most struggling teams.
